notes: ACCESS: Direct HTTP fetch via curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome124) succeeded on all pages (homepage, mega-menu, category pages, sitemap, product pages) - tier (a) sufficient, no Playwright/Chrome needed. robots.txt (https://www.xenos.nl/robots.txt) has no Anthropic/Claude-specific disallow; general User-agent:* disallows only query-param/vendor/customer/admin/checkout/compare/print paths, none of which were used. TREE: Built from union of (1) homepage mega-menu (div.mega-menu, 558 links), (2) each candidate parent category's own in-page subcategory links (woontextiel, keuken-en-tafeltextiel, opbergers, bad-en-douche, wassen-en-drogen), (3) product sitemap (storage/sitemap/default/sitemap.xml, product-URL slugs used only to sanity-check for missed categories, e.g. 'gordijn' slugs). Found one node absent from mega-menu via in-page subnav: tafelen/keuken-en-tafeltextiel/tafellopers (Table Runners, qty 0). huishouden/opbergers/schoenenopbergers canonicalizes to schoenenrek (duplicate, not recorded separately). QTY: taken from the H1 heading on each canonical category page, format 'Alle <Name>(<N>)', confirmed canonical URL matches requested slug on every node (protects against silent parent/site-wide fallback numbers). EXCLUDED - Textile: Rolgordijnen (Roller Blinds, /woonaccessoires/rolgordijnen, 13 items) - sitemap sampling of the 47 product-URL variants shows the category is dominated by bamboe (bamboo, woven natural-material) blinds with only one fabric-print line; textile.md 5 only includes roller blinds 'when clearly textile/fabric' and bamboo blinds are not fabric, quantity cannot be split by material without per-product inspection, so excluded rather than force a mixed count. Servetringen (napkin rings, /tafelen/keuken-en-tafeltextiel/servetten/servetringen, 13) - rings/holders, not fabric, textile.md hardware boundary. Schaduwdoeken (shade cloths/sails, /tuin/schaduwdoeken, 1) - functional sun-protection tarp for balcony/garden, not a home-furnishing textile product. Deurgordijnen (door curtains) appear as product slugs in the sitemap (e.g. deurgordijn-macrame-95x200-cm) but no live category/subcategory listing page exists for them (probed /woonaccessoires/deurgordijnen, /huishouden/deurgordijnen, /deurgordijnen, /woonaccessoires/gordijnen - all 404); no valid URL to record, so excluded (no fabrication of a listing URL). EXCLUDED - Storage: huishouden/bad-en-douche siblings toiletrolhouders, zeepbakjes, zeeppompjes, tandenborstelbekers, toiletborstels, badkamer-prullenbakken, badkamer-accessoires - bathroom accessories/fixtures/cleaning tools, not primarily storage containers. huishouden/wassen-en-drogen/wasknijpers (clothespins) - not storage. meubels/kasten and its children (vakkenkasten, ladekasten, dressoir, kast-met-deuren, tv-meubels, boekenkasten) - explicit Meubels (Furniture) navigation branch, out of scope for this task (handled by Furniture.xlsx, not touched). reizen-en-vrije-tijd/bagage/koffer-organizers (suitcase organizers) - travel accessory, not home storage. Neither Textile nor Storage: kaarsen*, spiegels, verlichting-en-lampen, wanddecoratie, ornamenten, bloemen-en-planten, fotolijsten, klokken, deurknoppen, lantaarns (decorative/lighting/wall-decor, other tasks' scope); tafelen/servies/glazen/bestek/serveren/koken/bakspullen/etc (Kitchen and Dining, other scope); eten-en-drinken, hobby, feest, reizen-en-vrije-tijd (excl. above), cadeaus (food, hobby, party, travel, gifts - unrelated departments). No View-All/Collection/search/product-detail URLs used anywhere.
